_comment: SINGLE-DRONE FLIGHT TEST (real HULA over pyhulax). The minimal 'ascend -> scan for a landing pad -> land on it' unit test. Phase chain [takeoff, land_on_pad] ONLY — NO navigate, so NO surveyed arena/sector is needed: land_on_pad is a position-blind VISUAL servo and its PAD_ACQUIRE stage is itself a bounded rotate-SCAN of the FOV. SETUP: place the test pad WITHIN the launch point's camera footprint (rotating in place cannot translate to a pad parked metres away). MARKER: vision/aruco.py decodes DICT_7X7_1000 (the field dict) in flight -> the test pad MUST carry a DICT_7X7_1000 marker, and valid_marker_ids below MUST be that marker's id (override via flight_test.py --marker-id, or edit here). camera_hfov_deg 71 = HULA manual. Budgets are a MAX (the orchestrator exits on all-DONE). Run via finals/tools/flight_test.py (it arms the abort + the GO gate); this file is the curated config it launches.

guards._comment: landing_reserve_s 30: MissionClockGuard lands the drone 30 s before the budget so it is never airborne at expiry. battery_warn_pct 30 -> advisory before the 20 % floor. No geofence (no surveyed arena here).

drones._comment: The one test airframe. plane_id 1 is a PLACEHOLDER — set it to the real drone's Dola plane_id (flight_test.py --plane-id, or edit). led_rgb red = identity.

land_on_pad._comment: valid_marker_ids [0] is a PLACEHOLDER — set to your DICT_7X7_1000 test-pad marker id (flight_test.py --marker-id N). acquire_timeout_s 40 over total_budget_s 120 gives a deliberate rotate-scan sweep (acquire_scan_step_deg 30 deg, scan_dwell_s 0.8 s) before any blind-land fallback. commit_alt_m 0.5 + k_lateral are ONSITE-CALIBRATED (gate F).
